title: ZEUS Board Meeting Minutes
content:
ZEUS Board Meeting Minutes · Page 1
Section 1 records the meeting header and attendance.
The regular meeting of the Board of Directors of ZEUS was held
on 2024-05-09 at 09:00 UTC at the Rotterdam office and by
video conference. The Chair was Elin Vasari.
Directors present: Elin Vasari, Marc Hedlund, Adaeze Nwankwo,
Tomoko Ishikawa and Rafael Santos. Directors absent: Anneke
Vermeer and Yusuf Demir. 5 of 7 directors were present and
the Chair declared a quorum.
Also present: Daniel Okonkwo, Chief Financial Officer, for the
financial items only. There was no other business.

ZEUS Board Meeting Minutes · Page 2
Section 2 records the resolutions adopted at the meeting held
on 2024-05-09. Three resolutions were put to the vote.
Resolution 1, quarterly dividend. The Board approved a
quarterly dividend of USD 0.85 per share, payable on
2024-06-14. The vote was 5 in favour, 2 against and 0
abstentions.
Resolution 2, capital programme. The Board approved FY2024
capital expenditure of USD 36,500,000, allocated across the
AEGIS and HELIOS product lines. The vote was 6 in favour, 1
against and 0 abstentions.
Resolution 3, shareholder proposal. The shareholder proposal
requesting a dual-class share structure was declined. The vote
was 6 against, 1 in favour and 0 abstentions.
